# ImageKit

ImageKit.io is a comprehensive media management solution offering real-time image and video optimization, transformation, and delivery through a global content delivery network (CDN).

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/imagekit-io/.

## Actions

- **Create Folder**: Create a new folder.
- **Delete File**: Delete a file.
- **Get File Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific file.
- **Get Upload Authentication Parameters** (read-only): Generate authentication parameters for client-side file uploads.
- **Get Usage** (read-only): Retrieve account usage metrics.
- **List and Search Assets** (read-only): List and search assets in your ImageKit account.
- **Rename File**: Rename a file.
- **Update File Details**: Update details of a file.
- **Bulk Job Status** (read-only): Check status of a bulk job.
- **Bulk Move Files**: Move multiple files in bulk.
- **Bulk Remove Tags**: Remove tags from multiple files in bulk.
- **Check purge cache status** (read-only): Check the status of a cache purge request.
- **Copy Folder**: Initiate a bulk copy of a folder.
- **Create Custom Metadata Field**: Create a custom metadata field.
- **Delete Custom Metadata Field**: Delete a custom metadata field.
- **Delete File Version**: Delete a specific non-current file version.
- **Delete Folder**: Delete a folder.
- **Delete Multiple Files**: Delete multiple files.
- **Get File Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve metadata of an uploaded file.
- **Get File Version Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific file version.
- **List Custom Metadata Fields** (read-only): List all custom metadata fields.
- **List File Versions** (read-only): List all versions of a file.
- **Move Folder**: Initiate a bulk move of a folder.
- **Purge ImageKit Cache**: Purge CDN and ImageKit caches for a given URL.
- **Restore File Version**: Restore a specific non-current file version as the current one.
- **Update Custom Metadata Field**: Update an existing custom metadata field.
